about: BK-12 (P-448, P-452; Bake plan row 26): the Sample case each combination opens, by its combination key: data, never code. Read by api/src/sample-case.ts (sampleCasesFrom), which names no combination: a pathway gets its own Sample case by an entry here alone. 'story': the combination whose Sample case the demo story opens (DEMO.md rows 11-12, the configured checkpoint and the finished story). Per combination: 'reference' (the case's reference; lower-cased, it starts every idempotency key, so loading twice opens the same case), 'principal' (the principal applicant's name on the case), 'people' (each further person: an id the answers use, a role from the release and the name shown), 'answers' (a file in samples/ in the shape of sample-family-imm5257.json: 'case', 'everyone', 'people' by id, optional 'job_place', 'not_answered' and 'none_apply'), and optionally 'record' (the ids whose facts come from the existing sample record, engine/import.ts sampleFamilyFacts), 'made_up' (facts made up per id, each labelled Sample), 'family_name_from_principal' (ids given the principal's family name from the record) and 'validated' (the saved read-backs of this case's copies, api/src/sample-validated.ts). Status: Sample (AGENTS rule 4): made-up people, never a client, never submitted. Unconfirmed: expert. Legal: Unconfirmed: no counsel.

vv.single.about: Sample: the family of four of DEMO.md rows 11-12 (QA-231, C10.1 rows 11-12, B99), as api/src/sample-case.ts opened it before BK-12. The record has one child and no child's date of birth: the second child's name and both children's dates of birth are made up here, labelled Sample.

sp.outside.about: Sample (BK-12, BK-13 step 2): the walk's family applying from outside Canada: a married student, the spouse (an open work permit) and a child who will not study (a visitor), so the Study permit opens its own Sample case by data alone (P-449's run). Every value is made up; none is an IRCC value.
